30262/p28: "I'm {kw:25:1:Melissa}Melissa. I was created from mud by Zeus, and I've been assigned to look after you."
30262/p29: "Oops, don't call them mud dolls. After all, in many myths, humans are said to have been born from mud and clay."
30262/p30: "Following that example, Zeus also used mud... but his power was insufficient, and he couldn't fully become human."
30262/p31: In short, I think it's a mud doll.
30262/p32: Before I could even respond, Melissa continued her explanation without pause.
30262/p33: He spoke with such a charming, good-natured air.
30262/p34: "If I hadn't safely become human, you wouldn't have been summoned, you know?"
30262/p35: "My current duty is to be your caretaker... but I've lived in the Garden longer than you have, so as your senior, I'll take good care of you."
30262/p36: "If you're worried about something, don't hesitate to talk to me. If you need to cry, you can always borrow my chest."
30262/p37: The way he gently patted my chest with a small cloth was so adorable that it healed my heart just by looking at it.
30262/p39: It's quite amusing, the contrast between his adorable appearance and his surprisingly deep voice.
30262/p40: "That's right. I heard from Zeus about the issue in your room, so I've taken care of it."
30262/p41: "Take your time and enjoy a bath without a care today. If there's anything else you need, just let me know, Kusanagi-san."
30262/p43: Come to think of it, I think I heard him call me that just now too.
30262/p44: "Well then, I'm heading to my room. See ya."
30262/p45: With that said, he scrambled up the leg of the table...
30262/p46: Before I realized it, the dollhouse door had been set up, and he had vanished inside.
30262/p47: It seems he's decided to make my room his own.
30262/p48: Still reeling from having such a lively housemate, I headed straight for the bath, it being my first soak in a day.
30263/p0: Being immersed in the water brought memories of the bath at my family home.
30263/p1: I desperately sank my body into the low, Western-style bathtub, trying to stay in the world of my memories for as long as possible.
30263/p2: It was the second day of school, but the finish line was still nowhere in sight.
